description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Table Storage implementation of transactional state storage in the Orleans framework. It includes test setup, table initialization, and a test class with methods to verify storage behavior.

classes.name: TestState
classes.description: A simple state class implementing IEquatable for testing purposes. It contains an integer State property and implements equality based on this property.

classes.name: AzureTransactionalStateStorageTests
classes.description: A test class inheriting from TransactionalStateStorageTestRunnerxUnit, with setup for Azure Table Storage transactional state storage testing, including methods for initializing the storage and the Azure table.

methods.name: StateStorageFactory
methods.description: Creates and initializes an AzureTableTransactionalStateStorage instance for testing, setting up necessary Azure Table resources.

methods.name: InitTableAsync
methods.description: Creates the Azure Storage table if it doesn't exist, and returns a TableClient for operations.

methods.name: GetCloudTableCreationClient
methods.description: Retrieves the TableServiceClient used to manage Azure Storage tables.
